name: Sunmory Arc Floor Lamp
description: A slim arc floor lamp that reaches out over a sofa or reading chair, placing light exactly where an overhead fixture cannot. The metal stem and hanging shade adjust to angle the glow just so, and the bulb shifts between three colour temperatures — warm and low for the evening, brighter and cooler for reading.

name: Acanva Curved-Back Velvet Sofa
description: A three-seater with a softly curved back and a tight, tailored velvet cover — minimal in its lines, yet plush to sink into. The low, clean silhouette suits an apartment living room, adding warmth and a quiet sense of luxury without crowding the room.

name: Acanva Zola Modular Sectional
description: An L-shaped modular sofa with a movable ottoman and a solid wood frame, cut in a clean, minimalist line. Rearrange the sections to suit the room, and the same sofa serves a wide apartment or a smaller corner equally well.

name: T4TREAM Fluted 6-Drawer Dresser
description: A six-drawer chest with a fluted front and a gently curved profile, finished in a natural oak tone with a faux-marble top. Wide and low, it works as a bedroom chest or a living-room media unit — a surface above, and the clutter hidden below.

name: CHITA Swivel Velvet Armchair
description: A barrel-backed swivel armchair in soft velvet, arriving fully assembled. It turns easily to follow the conversation or the light, at home in a living-room corner, a bedroom, or a study.

name: Acanva Mellow Accent Chair
description: An accent chair with a softly curved back and a tailored velvet cover over a solid wood frame. Ready to use out of the box, it slips into a quiet corner of almost any room.

name: Srugn Washable Vintage Rug
description: A washable rug with a faded, vintage-style print and a soft, low pile. Machine-friendly and non-slip, it warms a floor without the upkeep of a traditional weave.

name: Machine-Washable Boho Rug
description: A washable area rug with a relaxed boho pattern and a low, easy-care pile that lifts straight into the machine — a forgiving choice for busy rooms.

name: Soalmost Washable Area Rug
description: A soft, low-pile area rug with a quiet vintage print, made to be washed and laid back down. Non-slip and lightweight, it is easy to lift and easy to live with.

name: Pauwer Washable Area Rug
description: A washable area rug with a low 0.2-inch pile and a non-slip backing — soft underfoot but flat enough for chairs to move over. Machine washable, and easy to keep that way.

name: SWGRT Boho Plush Rug
description: A high-low plush rug with a subtle boho texture, soft underfoot and fully washable. Durable and non-slip, it anchors a room without demanding attention.

name: Lofus Abstract Area Rug
description: A washable area rug with a soft abstract pattern, a dense low pile and a non-slip rubber backing. Calm and modern, it settles a room without drawing attention to itself.

name: Stellhome Linen Cushion Covers
description: A pair of plain cushion covers in a natural linen weave, with the slightly rough, open texture linen is loved for. Nothing printed and nothing shiny — they simply add a soft, honest layer to a sofa or a bed.

name: Meekio Linen-Blend Cushion Covers
description: A pair of plain covers in a linen blend, softer to the touch than pure linen and easier to keep. A quiet, unpatterned layer that sits well against a darker sofa or a pale bed.

name: Foindtower Linen Cushion Covers
description: A pair of solid linen-look covers with a soft, even weave and a hidden zip. Plain and unfussy, they layer easily with the other textures in a room rather than competing with them.

name: MIULEE Chenille Cushion Covers
description: A pair of covers in soft chenille, which catches the light a little differently from linen and feels warmer under the hand. A good way to add depth to a seating group without adding pattern.

name: Cozoomy Textured Cushion Covers
description: A set of four textured covers, enough to dress a whole sofa or a bed in one go. The raised weave gives a plain room something to catch the eye without introducing colour.

name: MIULEE Striped Jacquard Cushion Covers
description: A pair of covers with a fine woven stripe rather than a printed one, so the pattern sits in the cloth itself. Quiet enough to mix with plain covers on the same sofa.

name: Topfinel Corduroy Cushion Covers
description: A pair of covers in a soft corduroy with a patchwork of ribbed panels. The ridges read as texture rather than decoration, which suits a room where the colours are kept quiet.

name: YCOLL Striped Patchwork Cushion Covers
description: A pair of covers in a two-tone stripe, pieced from panels so the pattern stays soft and irregular. A gentle way to bring a slightly deeper tone into a pale seating group.

name: Utopia Bedding Cushion Inserts
description: The inner pads that go inside cushion covers, sold in a set of four with a soft down-alternative filling. Softer and more yielding than a firm pad, so a cover settles into a relaxed shape rather than standing to attention.

name: MIULEE Cushion Inserts
description: A set of four inner pads with a firmer fibre filling and a brushed cover, made to hold their shape rather than sink. Worth knowing if you prefer a cushion that stands up on a sofa rather than one you sink into.

name: Simple&Opulence Linen Duvet Cover Set
description: A three-piece set in washed flax linen, with a duvet cover and two pillowcases and coconut buttons instead of a zip. Linen breathes, softens with every wash, and looks better creased than pressed — which is exactly what a bed wants.

name: Bedsure PureWoven Striped Duvet Cover Set
description: A three-piece set in washed cotton percale, woven with a fine yarn-dyed stripe that sits in the cloth rather than printed on it. Crisp and breathable, and it softens with washing the way good cotton should.

name: Bedsure Easy-Care Duvet Cover Set
description: A three-piece set in prewashed brushed microfibre, with a duvet cover and two shams. It is a synthetic rather than a natural fibre, which means it creases far less and washes hard — the practical choice for a bed that has to be made in a hurry.

name: IFGET Arched Fluted Sideboard
description: A long sideboard made up of three separate cabinets, with fluted arched doors and shelves that sit at three heights. It comes flat and takes a couple of hours to build with a second pair of hands, and it clears the floor enough underneath for a robot vacuum.

name: PoKat Ceramic Table Lamps
description: A pair of ceramic lamps sized for a bedside or an end table, sold together so both sides of a bed can match. The shade goes on at home, and the bulb is bought separately.

name: ROTTOGOON Linen-Shade Floor Lamp
description: A standing lamp with a fabric shade and a warm bulb included, switched with a foot pedal so you never have to reach for it. It stands beside a chair or a sofa without taking much floor.

name: MONVANE Modular Cloud Sofa
description: Six separate pieces that can be set out as one long run, an L, or a U, and pulled apart again when the room changes. It arrives compressed and needs about three days to reach its full shape, with no assembly beyond unpacking.

name: LOMANTO Artificial Olive Tree
description: A tall faux olive tree that arrives in sections and comes already potted. It is artificial, so it asks nothing of you beyond dusting and bending the branches back into shape after unpacking — useful in a corner where daylight never reaches.

name: Carrot's Den Ceramic Vase Set
description: Two matte ceramic vases in slightly different heights, made to stand together or apart. They hold water, so dried stems and cut branches both work, and the finish is a soft off-white rather than a glossy one.

name: Yalikop Wood Link Object
description: A small carved wooden piece of three joined links, meant to sit on a shelf or a low table and do nothing but catch the eye. It is the kind of object a cleared surface asks for once everything else has been put away.

name: TONOR Wood Slat Wall Panels
description: Wood-veneer slats mounted on a felt backing, fixed to the wall with adhesive or screws. They warm a bare wall and take the edge off echo in a room with hard floors, though they do have to be cut and fitted, so they suit a wall you own.

name: KLOGTSIND Magnetic Curtain Tiebacks
description: A pair of tiebacks strung with wooden beads and closed with magnets, so a curtain is held open without hooks or drilling. The cord stretches, which lets the same pair work on anything from a sheer to a heavy blackout curtain.

name: ELEHUME Asymmetrical Wall Mirror
description: A wall mirror with an irregular outline and a slim metal frame, hung on hooks already fitted to the back. Sized for a stretch of wall above a console rather than a full-length view.

name: Artificial Olive Tree with Lights
description: A faux olive tree that arrives potted and threaded with a warm string light, which can be left steady, set to flash, or simply switched off. The branches come compressed and need opening out by hand once it is standing.

name: MIULEE Striped Corduroy Cushion Covers
description: A pair of covers in soft corduroy with a fine ribbed stripe and a hidden zip. Polyester, so they wash and dry easily and hold their tone through it.

name: MIULEE Plain Corduroy Cushion Cover Set
description: Four plain corduroy covers in one tone, enough to dress a whole sofa without mixing. The ribbing gives a flat colour something to catch the light, so the set reads as texture rather than pattern.

name: Heart Ceramic Vase Set
description: Two ceramic vases of different heights, each cut through with an open heart. The finish is a matte sand glaze rather than a gloss, and the neck is narrow enough to hold dried stems upright.

name: SAMIAH LUXE Chunky Knit Throw
description: A chunky cable-knit throw in polyester chenille, heavy enough to hold its shape over a sofa arm and soft enough to actually pull over you. It washes on a gentle cycle without going out of shape, and carries OEKO-TEX certification for the substances that standard covers.

name: blunique Faux Fur Throw
description: A faux fur throw with a raised bubble texture on one face and a short plush on the other. It arrives vacuum-packed and flattened, so it needs a wash and a tumble before it reaches the loft shown on the listing.

name: FJSPERM Ceramic Vase Set
description: Three small ceramic vases in three different shapes, made to stand as a group rather than alone. They hold water, so cut stems work as well as dried ones, and each is small enough to sit on a coffee table without crowding it.

name: Honyee Full-Length Mirror
description: A full-length mirror with an irregular outline and a wooden frame wrapped in padded fabric, so the edge reads as soft rather than hard. It can lean against a wall or be hung, and it is tall enough to dress in front of.

name: Cozy Bliss Faux Fur Throw
description: A faux fur throw with the same raised wave on the face and a fleece backing, finished in a tonal wash rather than a flat colour. Like the others it comes compressed, so a wash and a low tumble bring it back to full loft.

name: Riskioir Arched Full-Length Mirror
description: A tall arched floor mirror in a slim aluminium frame, made to lean on its stand or hang flat against the wall. The glass is backed with a safety film, so a knock cracks it rather than scattering it.

name: BEAUTYPEAK Rectangle Full-Length Mirror
description: A full-length mirror squared off rather than arched, in a thin aluminium frame. It leans, stands on its own bracket or mounts to the wall, and the tempered glass carries the same anti-shatter backing.

name: Fenmzee Pull-Chain Bedside Lamps
description: A pair of bedside lamps worked by a pull chain, which steps the light through three temperatures — warm for the evening, cooler for reading. Each base carries a spare socket, and the bulbs come in the box.

name: Fenmzee Touch Bedside Lamp
description: A bedside lamp dimmed by touching the base, through three levels from a low night glow up to enough light to read by. It carries USB-A, USB-C and a spare socket, so the phone charges without a second adapter on the table. Bulb included.

name: EDISHINE Wooden Tripod Table Lamp
description: A small table lamp on a wooden tripod under a linen-look shade, light enough to move around and braced widely enough not to tip. It takes a few minutes to assemble, and the bulb is bought separately.

name: Seealle Ceramic Table Lamps
description: A pair of ceramic lamps on slim metal stems under linen-look shades, sold together so both sides of a bed can match. They fit together without tools, and the bulb is bought separately.

name: Xixini Fluted 9-Drawer Dresser
description: A wide chest with a rippled fluted front and splayed legs, its nine drawers deep enough to swallow a season of folding. The top is braced to take a lamp and a tray, and an anti-tip strap is in the box.

name: EliteSet Curved 9-Drawer Dresser
description: A nine-drawer chest with rounded corners rather than sharp ones, raised on adjustable legs with enough clearance underneath for a robot vacuum. It arrives in two boxes and takes about an hour to build.

name: Aitjunz Bentwood Nightstand
description: A bedside table with two handle-less drawers and an open shelf above them, its edges bent and rounded rather than cut square. A charging station sits at the back with two sockets and two USB ports, and a cable hole keeps the leads out of sight.

name: LEYAOYAO Fluted Nightstand
description: A bedside table with two deep drawers behind a fluted front, wide enough to hold a lamp and still leave the top usable. It carries the same built-in charging station — two sockets, two USB ports and a hole at the back for the cable.

name: DreamSky Wooden Alarm Clock
description: A plug-in bedside clock in a wooden case, with a display that dims through six levels down to something you can sleep beside. The alarm volume adjusts as well, and a battery holds the alarm and the settings through a power cut.

name: Allewie Lift-Up Storage Bed Frame
description: An upholstered frame whose base lifts on gas struts, turning the whole footprint of the bed into storage — worth knowing where there are no cupboards to spare. Wooden slats carry the mattress directly, so no box spring is needed.

name: VECELO Upholstered Storage Bed Frame
description: An upholstered frame with four wheeled drawers set into the base, and a headboard that fixes at three heights to suit the depth of the mattress. A metal inner frame under the slats is what keeps it from creaking.

name: Allewie Channel-Tufted Storage Bed Frame
description: An upholstered frame with four deep drawers on wheels beneath it and a headboard that fixes at two heights. The reinforced metal frame and slats hold the mattress directly, without a box spring.

name: T4TREAM Fluted Bed Frame with Storage Bench
description: A frame with fluted panels across both the headboard and the footboard, and a bench built into the foot of it holding two drawers and two lift-up compartments. Engineered wood over a steel frame; it takes two people to assemble.

name: T4TREAM Fluted Nightstand
description: A bedside table with two deep drawers behind a fluted front and softly rounded corners. Two sockets, a USB-C and a USB port sit along the top edge rather than behind it, so nothing has to be felt for in the dark.

name: Casper Original Memory Foam Mattress
description: A memory foam mattress in a medium-firm feel, built in three layers with firmer foam under the hips and lower back. The open-cell top layer is made to move air rather than hold it, and it ships compressed in a box with a hundred-night trial.

name: Nectar Memory Foam Mattress
description: A memory foam mattress built up in five layers under a cooling cover, with contouring foam over a firmer support layer beneath it. Made without fibreglass, it arrives rolled in a box and takes about a day to reach full shape, and the trial period runs a whole year.

name: Casper Element Mattress
description: The plainest construction Casper makes — two layers rather than three, in a medium feel with no zoning through the middle. The same open-cell foam moves air rather than holding it, and the hundred-night trial applies.

name: Novilla Bliss Gel Memory Foam Mattress
description: A gel memory foam mattress in four layers, with the gel worked into the top so it carries heat away instead of trapping it. The edges are reinforced to hold their shape when you sit on the side, and it ships rolled, taking up to three days to expand fully.

name: POVISON Sintered Stone Round Dining Table
description: A round table with a sintered stone top on a curved steel base. Sintered stone takes heat and resists oil and staining, so a hot dish set down on it is not a crisis. It is heavy — three hundred pounds — and comes in two packages that may not arrive together; lifting the top onto the base takes two people.

name: MECHYIN Round Dining Table with Shelf
description: A round table on an X-shaped steel base with a shelf underneath for the things a dining room collects. The top is sealed board, resistant to heat, scratches and water, and it comes as two panels rather than four, so there are fewer seams across the surface.

name: LITTLE TREE Rectangular Dining Table
description: A rectangular table on heavy steel legs, with a thick engineered-wood top finished to resist scratches and wipe down with a damp cloth. The legs are set in from the corners, so chairs still tuck underneath.

name: Tribesigns Fluted Round Dining Table
description: A round table with a fluted base and a textured board top on a metal frame. The feet adjust for floors that are not quite level, and it is rated to hold three hundred pounds.

name: Devoko Acacia Wood Dining Table
description: Solid acacia timber rather than a board material — over two inches thick, sanded smooth, on painted steel legs. It is treated to stand outdoors as well as in, though it wants oiling now and then if it lives outside. One person can put it together in about ten minutes.

name: ONBRILL Pedestal Round Dining Table
description: A round table on a square pedestal, so there are no legs at the corners to work a chair around. The top is a thick engineered board, and the foot of the base is rounded off rather than left square.

name: RIVOVA Linen Dining Chairs
description: A set of six upholstered chairs in linen, with a curved back and a deep foam seat on solid wood legs. Each takes about ten minutes to assemble, and the covers are spot-cleaned rather than taken off.

name: NEW JETO Metal Bed Frame
description: A plain steel frame on reinforced rods with centre support legs, raised high enough to keep boxes and cases underneath rather than elsewhere. Steel slats carry the mattress directly, so no box spring is needed, and the edges are polished smooth enough to wipe with a damp cloth.
